arXiv:2607.10063v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bismuth monolayer is the first two-dimensional elemental ferroelectric and an appealing platform for coupling polar order to spin-orbit-driven topology. item.title: Transport in magnetic-topological-insulator nanoribbons containing multiple superconductor-proximitized sectors
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Javier Osca, Sungguen Ryu, Rosa López, Llorenç Serra
arXiv:2607.10665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transport in devices with multiple proximitized sectors depends heavily on the complex phases of the pairing gaps of those sectors. We investigate magnetic topological insulator nanoribbons in two- and three-terminal setups with proximitized sectors and asymptotic normal leads. Our focus is on the regime of single chiral Majoranas. The characteristic electric and thermal interferometries of chiral Majoranas can be controlled by the complex phases of the pairing. We predict an AC Majorana effect, in which phase dynamics induced by a voltage bias generate measurable time-dependent conductance oscillations. A three-terminal junction with superconducting islands can be used as a Majorana router when the relative complex phases are configured.
